verses.t: And they walked about in the midst of the flames, singing hymns to Aluahim and blessing Yahuah. Supplied – the printed source omits this verse.
Then Azariah stood and offered this prayer; in the midst of the fire he opened his mouth and said:
"Baruk art thou, O Yahuah, Aluahim of our fathers, and worthy of praise; and thy name is esteemed for ever.
For thou art just in all that thou hast done to us, and all thy works are true and thy ways right, and all thy mishpatim are truth.

Thou hast executed true mishpatim in all that thou hast brought upon us and upon Yahrushalayim, the qadash (Set Apart) city of our fathers, for in truth and justice thou hast brought all this upon us because of our sins.
For we have sinfully and lawlessly departed from thee, and have sinned in all things and have not obeyed thy mitsvot;
we have not observed them or done them, as thou hast commanded us that it might go well with us.
So all that thou hast brought upon us, and all that thou hast done to us, thou hast done in true mishpat.
Thou hast given us into the hands of lawless enemies, most hateful rebels, and to an unjust king, the most wicked in all the world.
And now we cannot open our mouths; shame and disgrace have befallen thy servants and worshipers.
For thy name's sake do not give us up utterly, and do not break thy berith,
and do not withdraw thy mercy from us, for the sake of Aḇraham thy beloved and for the sake of Yahtsḥaq thy servant and Yasharal thy qadash (Set Apart One),
to whom thou didst promise to make their descendants as many as the stars of shamayim and as the sand on the shore of the sea.
For we, O Yahuah, have become fewer than any nation, and are brought low this day in all the world because of our sins.
And at this time there is no prince, or naḇi, or leader, no burnt offering, or sacrifice, or oblation, or incense, no place to make an offering before thee or to find mercy.
Yet with a contrite heart and a humble ruach may we be accepted, as though it were with burnt offerings of rams and bulls, and with tens of thousands of fat lambs;
such may our sacrifice be in thy sight this day, and may we wholly follow thee, for there will be no shame for those who trust in thee.
And now with all our heart we follow thee, we fear thee and seek thy face.
Do not put us to shame, but deal with us in thy forbearance and in thy abundant mercy.
Deliver us in accordance with thy marvelous works, and give esteem to thy name, O Yahuah! Let all who do harm to thy servants be put to shame;
let them be disgraced and deprived of all power and dominion, and let their strength be broken.
Let them know that thou art Yahuah, the only Aluahim, esteemed over the whole world."
Now the king's servants who threw them in did not cease feeding the furnace fires with naphtha, pitch, tow, and brush.
And the flame streamed out above the furnace forty-nine cubits,
and it broke through and burned those of the Chaldeans whom it caught about the furnace.
But the mal'ak of Yahuah came down into the furnace to be with Azariah and his companions, and drove the fiery flame out of the furnace,
and made the midst of the furnace like a moist whistling ruach, so that the fire did not touch them at all or hurt or trouble them.
Then the three, as with one mouth, praised and esteemed and baruk Aluahim in the furnace, saying:
"Baruk art thou, O Yahuah, Aluahim of our fathers, and to be praised and highly exalted for ever;
And baruk is thy esteemed, qadash (Set Apart) name and to be highly praised and highly exalted for ever;
Baruk art thou in the heykal of thy qadash (Set Apart) esteem and to be extolled and highly esteemed for ever.
Baruk art thou, who sittest upon cherubim and lookest upon the deeps, and to be praised and highly exalted for ever.
Baruk art thou upon the throne of thy kingdom and to be extolled and highly exalted for ever.
Baruk art thou in the firmament of heavenand to be sung and esteemed for ever.
"Bless Yahuah, all works of Yahuah, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, you shamayim, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, you mal'akim of Yahuah, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, all waters above the shamayim, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, all powers, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, sun and moon, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, stars of shamayim, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, all rain and dew, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, all ruchot, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, fire and heat, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, winter cold and summer heat, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, dews and snows, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, nights and days, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, light and darkness, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, ice and cold, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, frosts and snows, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, lightnings and clouds, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Let the earth bless Yahuah; let it sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, mountains and hills, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, all things that grow on the earth, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, you springs, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, seas and rivers, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, you whales and all creatures that move in the waters, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, all birds of the air, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, all beasts and cattle, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, you sons of men, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, O Yasharal, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, you kohanim of Yahuah, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, you servants of Yahuah sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, ruchot and nepheshoth of the righteous, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.
Bless Yahuah, you who are qadash (Set Apart) and humble in heart, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever.

Bless Yahuah, Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishaal, sing praise to him and highly exalt him for ever; for he has rescued us from Hades and saved us from the hand of death, and delivered us from the midst of the burning fiery furnace; from the midst of the fire he has delivered us.
Give thanks to Yahuah, for he is good, for his mercy endures for ever.
Bless him, all who worship Yahuah, the Aluahim of Aluahims, sing praise to him and give thanks to him, for his mercy endures for ever."
